message.content: Driving from San Francisco to Los Angeles is roughly 380–400 miles (about 610–640 km) along the I‑5 corridor. Under normal conditions—no major traffic, construction, or weather delays—a typical trip takes about **6 hours**. If you’re heading out during rush hour or on a weekend when traffic can be heavy, you might add an extra hour or two. Always check a live navigation app for real‑time traffic updates before you hit the road.

We can provide approximate distance (~383 miles via I-5) and typical driving time (~6 hours). But we might also mention traffic, speed limits, etc. There's no function call needed. Just answer.
